tsa-a01-v01.inference: Mother-Father flash forth the Heart; the book promises plain essence; the lineage-lotus is to be gathered for worship.
premises: Stainless-art-abode, new-creation-great Mother; full-bodied, five-hidden-faced Father.
Their yamal-burst-forth being: the Heart — deathless clan beyond all — flash for me.
tsa-a01-v01.question: Whom invoke, and what flash forth?
tsa-a01-v01.speaker: Abhinavagupta (maṅgala voice, invoking)

tsa-a01-v02.inference: Vastness undiveable; therefore plain-spoken essence offered instead.
premises: Tantrāloka vast, by all unplungeable.
Therefore this Tantrasāra in plain words: listen.
tsa-a01-v02.question: Why condense, and how offered?
tsa-a01-v02.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice, promising)

tsa-a01-v03.inference: Lineage-feet uncontract the heart; the gathered lotus serves worship.
premises: By Śambhunātha-Bhāskara feet-fall splendor, contraction gone.
Abhinavagupta's heart-lotus: pick this — for Maheśa-worship's sake.
tsa-a01-v03.question: By what grace, and to what end?
tsa-a01-v03.speaker: Abhinavagupta (disciple voice, dedicating)

tsa-a01-v04.inference: Determination-knowledge (śāstra-grounded) removes both ignorances; the Lord's scripture alone fully frees; its essence-chain ends in the Mālinīvijaya, whose content no gathering exhausts.

option_choices.reason: Sandhi vikalpa+asaṃkucita (privative a- negating saṃkucita); avikalpāntatā doctrine just stated; OG word-by-word concurs (uncontracted by thought); frozen T1 gloss missed the privative

premises: Knowledge frees as opponent of bondage-cause ignorance.
Ignorance twofold: intellect-located (doubt-natured, wrong-conviction-natured); personal (thought-natured, contracted; root of saṃsāra).
Personal ignorance removable by initiation — but initiation needs prior shun-and-take determination, impossible while intellect cannot decide.
Therefore determinative intellect-dwelling knowledge is principal; practiced, it kills personal ignorance too (practice ends in thought-free).
Śāstra hierarchy: only Lord-spoken scripture fully authoritative (absorbs others discriminatively, out-argues them); others liberate partially.
Essence-chain: five streams, sixfold scriptures, Mālinīvijaya — whose contained content no gathering can expound.
Without expounded nature no freedom or freeing (only pure knowing so-natured); supreme goal rooted in well-practiced knowing — hence this book begins.

Ignorance declared bondage-cause, called stain; at full-knowing-digit rise it goes rootless; when self-consciousness rises with stains destroyed — liberation; so with this book all knowables revealed.
tsa-a01-v04.question: What liberates, and by what authority?
tsa-a01-v04.speaker: Abhinavagupta (siddhānta voice, establishing)
uncertainties: Mālinīvijaya inexhaustibility: noted as given, not resolved (deferred to the work itself).

tsa-a01-v05.inference: Own nature alone is to be adopted: one autonomous light-consciousness, resting in own bliss as Śiva; contracting itself, called atom; re-manifesting with or without means — will, knowing, action (three immersions) plus a fourth; the self hiding then spreading its own nature, stepwise or at once.
premises: Here own-nature alone supremely adoptable: light-nature of all things (non-light cannot be nature).
Not many: no other-nature enters light; no difference of nature; place-time (also light) do not divide.
Hence one light alone — and it is consciousness (thing-manifestation-natured; undisputed).
That light not dependent (illuminedness is dependence; needs another light; none exists).
Hence autonomous one light: by autonomy alone, unbounded by place-time-form, all-pervading, eternal, form/formless-natured.
Autonomy = bliss-power; its wonder = will-power; light-nature = consciousness-power; grasp = knowledge-power; all-form-fitness = action-power.
Though chief-powered, really will-knowing-acting-powered; unlimited light resting in own bliss is Śiva-natured.
He alone, by autonomy, manifesting self contracted, is called atom.
Again manifesting own self autonomously — shines as unlimited-light-Śiva-nature itself.
There too by autonomy: without means or with means; with means — will, knowing, or action as approach: threefold immersion (śāmbhava-śākta-āṇava); a fourth form too, taught here in order.
The self, light-bodied Śiva, autonomous — by autonomy-play force hiding own nature, then spreading it full, by sequence-nosequence force or threefold.
tsa-a01-v05.question: What is own-nature, and how does it hide and spread?
tsa-a01-v05.speaker: Abhinavagupta (siddhānta voice, revealing)
uncertainties: The fourth immersion beyond the three: stated as taught here, content deferred to the work. Upāya details deferred.

tsa-a01-v01.plain_english: Mother — stainless art's abode, great new creation, full-bodied; Father — his five faces' splendor hidden: may the Heart, born of the surging nature of their embrace, the deathless kin beyond the highest, flash forth for me.
tsa-a01-v01.sanskrit_cite: vimalakalāśrayābhinavasṛṣṭimahā jananī bharitatanuś ca pañcamukhaguptarucir janakaḥ | tadubhayayāmalasphuritabhāvavisargamayaṃ hṛdayam anuttarāmṛtakulaṃ mama saṃsphuratāt

tsa-a01-v02.plain_english: The Tantrāloka is vast, and no one at all can dive it; so hear this Tantrasāra, composed in plain words.
tsa-a01-v02.sanskrit_cite: vitatas tantrāloko vigāhituṃ naiva śakyate sarvaiḥ | ṛjuvacanaviracitam idaṃ tu tantrasāraṃ tataḥ śṛṇuta

tsa-a01-v03.plain_english: This lotus-heart of Abhinavagupta, its narrowness gone by the light shed from the falling feet of Śambhunātha the Sun — gather it for the sake of the Great Lord's worship.

tsa-a01-v04.plain_english: Here knowledge is the cause of liberation, since it opposes ignorance, the cause of bondage. Ignorance is twofold: located in the intellect, and personal. The intellect-located is doubt-natured and wrong-conviction-natured. The personal is thought-natured and contracted-manifestation-natured — and that itself is the root cause of saṃsāra, as will be taught under the determination of the stains. There, personal ignorance may be removed by initiation and the rest — but initiation itself is impossible while intellect-located, determination-less ignorance persists, since initiation is preceded by determination of shun-and-take and takes the form of principle-purification and Śiva-joining. Hence determinative, intellect-abiding knowledge is principal; practiced, that itself kills personal ignorance too, since thought-consciousness-practice ends in thought-free. For the self — consciousness-light uncontracted by thought — is Śiva-natured. Hence in all cases adopt all-thing-directed right-determination knowledge. And that is scripture-led: scripture authoritative only as Lord-spoken, since others' scripture-taught things are accepted there discriminatively and since there is reason-proved exposition beyond their content. Hence other-āgama-taught knowledge liberates only so far from bondage, not from all; from all liberates the Lord's scripture, five-streamed, ten-eighteen-eight-differentiated. Than all that, the essence is the sixfold scriptures; than those, the Mālinīvijaya — whose contained content, gathered, is impossible to expound. Nor is there freedom or liberating power for one whose thing-nature is unexpounded, since only pure knowledge is so-natured. Since the supreme goal is rooted in well-practiced knowledge, for its success this is begun. Ignorance, declared bondage-cause in scripture, is called stain; at the rise of the digit of full knowledge, all that goes rootless. When self-consciousness rises with remainderless destroyed stains — liberation too. Hence by this man, with scripture, I reveal entirely whatever knowable reality there may be.

tsa-a01-v05.plain_english: Here own-nature alone is supremely adoptable: light-nature of all things, since non-light cannot be nature. And it is not many, since no other natures enter light and natures do not differ; place and time too do not divide it, since they too are light-natured. Hence one light alone — and it is consciousness, since consciousness is of the nature of thing-manifestation; here for all there is no dispute. And that light is not dependent, since being-illumined is dependence, since illuminedness needs another light, and since no other light at all exists. Hence autonomous is the one light, and through autonomy alone, free from limitation by place, time, and form, all-pervading, eternal, of all-form-formless-nature. Of it autonomy is bliss-power; its wonder is will-power; light-nature is consciousness-power; grasp is knowledge-power; all-form-fitness is action-power. Thus though endowed with chief powers, really will-knowledge-action-powered, unlimited, the light resting in its own bliss is Śiva-natured. He alone, through autonomy manifesting self contracted, is called atom. And again he manifests own self autonomously — whereby he shines as unlimited-light-Śiva-nature itself. There too, through autonomy, he manifests own self without means or with means; and with means — will, knowing, or action as approach: hence threefoldness of immersion by śāmbhava-śākta-āṇava distinction. Therein all four forms too, in order, here are taught. The self, light-bodied, this Śiva, autonomous — by autonomy-play's force having hidden own nature, which again would spread forth full, that by sequence-nosequence force or threefold.

essence: Mother of stainless art and new creation, five-faced Father hidden in splendor: may their yamal-burst Heart, deathless kin beyond all, flash forth; the unplungeable ocean condensed to plain essence — hear it; the heart-lotus uncontracted by the master's feet gathered for worship.

Knowledge frees as opponent of bondage-cause ignorance, twofold: doubt-natured and wrong-conviction-natured in the intellect, thought-natured and contracted in the person — root of saṃsāra; initiation washes the personal but needs prior shun-and-take determination, impossible while intellect cannot decide; hence determinative intellect-dwelling knowledge is principal, and practiced kills the personal too, ending in thought-free; only Lord-spoken scripture fully authorizes and fully frees, five streams to sixfold books to inexhaustible Mālinīvijaya.

Own-nature alone is adoptable: one autonomous light-consciousness, all-pervading, eternal, form and formless; autonomy is bliss, wonder is will, light is consciousness, grasp is knowing, all-fitness is action; resting in own bliss it is Śiva, contracting itself called atom, re-manifesting with or without means — will, knowing, action, three immersions plus a fourth taught here in order.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta-śānta of invocation settling into teaching
rasa.justification: Opening wonder (maṅgala flash, unplungeable ocean, gathered lotus) settling into taught peace (determination, hierarchy, one light): invoked, asked in effect, answered in full.

sections.SUMMARY: Mother of stainless art and new great creation, full-bodied; Father of five hidden faces: may their yamal-burst-forth Heart — deathless kin beyond all — flash forth. The Tantrāloka spreads too wide to dive; therefore its essence in plain words — hear it. The heart-lotus, its narrowness gone by the feet-fall splendor of Śambhunātha the Sun, is gathered for the Great Lord's worship. Knowledge frees as opponent of bondage-cause ignorance, twofold: intellect-located doubt-nature and wrong-conviction-nature, personal thought-nature and contracted manifestation — root of saṃsāra. The personal washes by initiation, but initiation needs prior shun-and-take determination, impossible while intellect cannot decide; hence determinative intellect-dwelling knowledge leads, and practiced kills the personal too, ending in thought-free. Only Lord-spoken scripture fully authorizes and fully frees — five streams, sixfold scriptures, Mālinīvijaya whose contained content no gathering can expound. Own-nature alone is adoptable: one autonomous light-consciousness, all-pervading, eternal, form and formless; autonomy is bliss, wonder is will, light is consciousness, grasp is knowing, all-fitness is action. Resting in own bliss it is Śiva; contracting itself, called atom; re-manifesting with or without means — will, knowing, action: three immersions, plus a fourth taught here in order.

tsa-a01-v04.text: iha jñānaṃ mokṣakāraṇaṃ bandhanimittasya ajñānasya virodhakatvāt dvividhaṃ ca ajñānaṃ buddhigataṃ pauruṣaṃ ca tatra buddhigatam aniścayasvabhāvaṃ viparītaniścayātmakaṃ ca | pauruṣaṃ tu vikalpasvabhāvaṃ saṃkucitaprathātmakaṃ tad eva ca mūlakāraṇaṃ saṃsārasya iti vakṣyāmo malanirṇaye | tatra pauruṣam ajñānaṃ dīkṣādinā nivartetāpi kiṃ tu dīkṣāpi buddhigate anadhyavasāyātmake ajñāne sati na sambhavati heyopādeyaniścayapūrvakatvāt tattvaśuddhiśivayojanārūpāyā dīkṣāyā iti | tatra adhyavasāyātmakaṃ buddhiniṣṭham eva jñānaṃ pradhānam tad eva ca abhyasyamānaṃ pauruṣam api ajñānaṃ nihanti vikalpasaṃvidabhyāsasya avikalpāntatāparyavasānāt | vikalpāsaṃkucitasaṃvitprakāśarūpo hy ātmā śivasvabhāva iti sarvathā samastavastuniṣṭhaṃ samyaṅniścayātmakaṃ jñānam upādeyam | tac ca śāstrapūrvakam | śāstraṃ ca parameśvarabhāṣitam eva pramāṇam | aparaśāstroktānām arthānāṃ tatra vaiviktyena abhyupagamāt tadarthātiriktayuktisiddhanirūpaṇāc ca tena aparāgamoktaṃ jñānaṃ tāvata eva bandhāt vimocakam na sarvasmāt sarvasmāt tu vimocakaṃ parameśvaraśāstraṃ pañcasrotomayaṃ daśāṣṭādaśavasvaṣṭabhedabhinnam | tato 'pi sarvasmāt sāraṃ ṣaḍardhaśāstrāṇi | tebhyo 'pi mālinīvijayam | tadantargataś cārthaḥ saṃkalayyāśakyo nirūpayitum | na ca anirūpitavastutattvasya muktatvaṃ mocakatvaṃ vā śuddhasya jñānasyaiva tathārūpatvāt iti | svabhyastajñānamūlatvāt parapuruṣārthasya tatsiddhaye idam ārabhyate | ajñānaṃ kila bandhahetur uditaḥ śāstre malaṃ tat smṛtaṃ pūrṇajñānakalodaye tad akhilaṃ nirmūlatāṃ gacchati | dhvastāśeṣamalātmasaṃvidudaye mokṣaś ca tenāmunā śāstreṇa prakaṭīkaromi nikhilaṃ yaj jñeyatattvaṃ bhavet

tsa-a01-v05.text: tatra iha svabhāva eva paramopādeyaḥ sa ca sarvabhāvānāṃ prakāśarūpa eva aprakāśasya svabhāvatānupapatteḥ sa ca nānekaḥ prakāśasya taditarasvabhāvānupraveśāyoge svabhāvabhedābhāvāt deśakālāv api ca asya na bhedakau tayor api tatprakāśasvabhāvatvāt iti eka eva prakāśaḥ sa eva ca saṃvit arthaprakāśarūpā hi saṃvit iti sarveṣām atra avivāda eva | sa ca prakāśo na paratantraḥ prakāśyataiva hi pāratantryam prakāśyatā ca prakāśāntarāpekṣitaiva na ca prakāśāntaraṃ kiṃcit asti iti svatantra ekaḥ prakāśaḥ svātantryād eva ca deśakālākārāvacchedavirahāt vyāpako nityaḥ sarvākāranirākārasvabhāvaḥ tasya ca svātantryam ānandaśaktiḥ taccamatkāra icchāśaktiḥ prakāśarūpatā cicchaktiḥ āmarśātmakatā jñānaśaktiḥ sarvākārayogitvaṃ kriyāśaktiḥ ity evaṃ mukhyābhiḥ śaktibhiḥ yukto 'pi vastuta icchājñānakriyāśaktiyuktaḥ anavacchinnaḥ prakāśo nijānandaviśrāntaḥ śivarūpaḥ sa eva svātantryāt ātmānaṃ saṃkucitam avabhāsayan aṇur iti ucyate | punar api ca svātmānaṃ svatantratayā prakāśayati yena anavacchinnaprakāśaśivarūpatayaiva prakāśate | tatrāpi svātantryavaśāt anupāyam eva svātmānaṃ prakāśayati sopāyaṃ vā sopāyatve 'pi icchā vā jñānaṃ vā kriyā vā abhyupāya iti traividhyaṃ śāmbhavaśāktāṇavabhedena samāveśasya tatra caturvidham api etad rūpaṃ krameṇa atra upadiśyate | ātmā prakāśavapur eṣa śivaḥ svatantraḥ svātantryanarmarabhasena nijaṃ svarūpam | saṃchādya yat punar api prathayeta pūrṇaṃ tac ca kramākramavaśād athavā tribhedāt

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: opening wonder (maṅgala flash; FIRST VERSE — sets the house voice: vocative-pair invocation, dash-suspension, end-weight self; owner verdict required). Sanskrit-first: saṃsphuratāt = benedictive 3sg (may-it-FLASH — flash, not mere shine). Abhinavagupta frame: the invocation performs sādhāraṇīkaraṇa in reverse — the universal Heart summoned into this book, this reader (‘for me’ last). Rows: 7 (Mother…Father pair kept — direct address opens the work), 1 (mama end-weighted — ‘for me’ closes; the invocator's self last), 5 (bank: hymn-opening tread for śloka-source). Close: ‘for me’. Rejected: ‘shine’ for flash — killed: saṃsphuratāt is burst-flash; splitting Mother/Father across lines — killed: yāmala is one breath, the pair IS the doctrine. Read aloud: MO-ther of STAIN-less ART … FIVE-faced FA-ther … may the HEART flash-FORTH … FOR-me.

reads_against.argmap: Whom invoke, and what flash forth? → Mother-Father flash forth the Heart; the book promises plain essence; the lineage-lotus is to be gathered for worship.
c1_essence: Mother of stainless art and new creation, five-faced Father hidden in splendor: may their yamal-burst Heart, deathless kin beyond all, flash forth; the unplungeable ocean condensed to plain essence — hear it; the heart-lotus uncontracted by the master's feet gathered for worship.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of invocation settling into teaching

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: vastness yielding plainness. Sanskrit-first: vitataḥ (SPREAD — vastness as action, doctrine not décor) + naiva śakyate (not-possible AT ALL) + śṛṇuta (LISTEN! 2pl imperative — the song commands). Abhinavagupta frame: the ocean-to-essence move (unplungeable → plain words) is the whole Tantrasāra's apology and method. Rows: 5 (anastrophe ‘Wide spreads’ — hymn-opening inversion; word order freed for music, trace unchanged; bank: Holcombe word-order-in-joints), 1 (viracitam end-weighted — ‘composed’: made-ness as destination, the book IS the making). Close: ‘in plain words composed’. Rejected: ‘vast’ for ‘spreads wide’ — killed: vitataḥ acts; ‘listen’ for hear — killed: contemporary diction (license ledger), hear carries śṛṇuta. Read aloud: WIDE-spreads the tan-TRĀ-lo-ka — NONE at ALL can DIVE; SO-hear THIS tan-tra-SĀ-ra … com-POSED.

reads_against.argmap: Why condense, and how offered? → Vastness undiveable; therefore plain-spoken essence offered instead.
c1_essence: Mother of stainless art and new creation, five-faced Father hidden in splendor: may their yamal-burst Heart, deathless kin beyond all, flash forth; the unplungeable ocean condensed to plain essence — hear it; the heart-lotus uncontracted by the master's feet gathered for worship.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: gathered lotus (vicinuta = PICK! imperative of transmission). Sanskrit-first: apagatasaṃkocam (whose CONTRACTION IS GONE — uncontracted, kept) + maheśapūjanahetoḥ (for Maheśa-WORSHIP's sake — purpose-compound). Abhinavagupta frame: grace arrives as feet-fall light (pāta as touch, not argument); the disciple's only act is gathering. Rows: 1 (imperative gathered late — ‘gather it’ before the purpose-phrase), 2 (purpose-compound unpacked after colon — suspension then gathering; mirror-pause vs L3's dash). Close: ‘worship’ (pūjana end-weighted — purpose as destination). Rejected: ‘collect’ for gather — killed: vicinuta picks (flowers); fronting ‘for worship’ — killed: hetu lands last. Read aloud: HEART-lo-tus … un-con-TRACT-ed — BY śam-bhu-NĀ-tha SUN's FEET-fall LIGHT: GA-ther it for ma-HE-śa-WOR-ship.

reads_against.argmap: By what grace, and to what end? → Lineage-feet uncontract the heart; the gathered lotus serves worship.

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: determination over delusion (adhyavasāya = determining; the verse's engine). Sanskrit-first: re-read confirms order (initiation-barrier before determination-triumph) and the resolved asaṃkucita fork carried through. Abhinavagupta frame: jñāna-as-opponent (virodhin) — knowledge argued as enemy-of-ignorance, not lamp-in-dark; śāstra as the only full authorizer (five streams→sixfold→Mālinīvijaya, inexhaustible per UNC). Rows: 9 (twofold catalogue — doubt/wrong-conviction/churning each named; each ignorance named is a bond named), 1 (avikalpāntatā end-weighted ‘thought-free’; sarvasmāt ‘altogether’ closes on totality). Close: ‘frees altogether’. Rejected: smoothing the sextet catalogue — killed: naming IS the refutation; ‘mere thought’ for churning thought — killed: manana-churning is technical. Read aloud: KNOW-ledge FREES — two-FOLD … de-CID-ed SHUN-and-TAKE … PRAC-ticed, KILLS the PER-son-al TOO — THOUGHT-free.

reads_against.argmap: What liberates, and by what authority? → Determination-knowledge (śāstra-grounded) removes both ignorances; the Lord's scripture alone fully frees; its essence-chain ends in the Mālinīvijaya, whose content no gathering exhausts.
c1_essence: Knowledge frees as opponent of bondage-cause ignorance, twofold: doubt-natured and wrong-conviction-natured in the intellect, thought-natured and contracted in the person — root of saṃsāra; initiation washes the personal but needs prior shun-and-take determination, impossible while intellect cannot decide; hence determinative intellect-dwelling knowledge is principal, and practiced kills the personal too, ending in thought-free; only Lord-spoken scripture fully authorizes and fully frees, five streams to sixfold books to inexhaustible Mālinīvijaya.
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta-śānta of invocation settling into teaching

notes.craft_notes: Sthāyin: hiding-and-spreading (saṃchādya…prathayeta: having HIDDEN…would spread FORTH — concealment rhymed with revelation). Sanskrit-first: anavacchinnaprakāśaśivarūpatayaiva (as unlimited-light-Śiva-nature ITSELF — identity, not likeness). Abhinavagupta frame: svātantrya performed — freedom/bliss, wonder/will, light/awareness, grasp/knowing, fitness/action: each power named IS the autonomy proved. CORRECTED this pass: the old song had dropped ‘hiding his own nature’ + ‘will, knowing, action’ — the very concealment its own craft celebrated; restored from L3 (subset-safe: every restored word is L3's). Rows: 9 (powers drumbeat kept bare — doctrine resists ornament), 1 (pūrṇam end-weighted ‘full’: the song and the work end open-full), 5 (śāstra-tread: long catalogue-close line; bank: fidelity-first, music in the joints). Close: ‘to spread it full’. Rejected: keeping the old compressed close — killed: lost saṃchādya, the verse's engine; ornamenting the atom-line — killed: contraction stated plain; restoring ‘here taught’ — killed: UNC defers the fourth to the work. Read aloud: REST-ing in OWN-bliss, ŚI-va — con-TRACT-ing, CALLED-a-tom; HID-ing his OWN-na-ture … WILL, KNOW-ing, AC-tion — THREE-fold, FOUR-fold — to SPREAD it FULL.

reads_against.argmap: What is own-nature, and how does it hide and spread? → Own nature alone is to be adopted: one autonomous light-consciousness, resting in own bliss as Śiva; contracting itself, called atom; re-manifesting with or without means — will, knowing, action (three immersions) plus a fourth; the self hiding then spreading its own nature, stepwise or at once.
c1_essence: Own-nature alone is adoptable: one autonomous light-consciousness, all-pervading, eternal, form and formless; autonomy is bliss, wonder is will, light is consciousness, grasp is knowing, all-fitness is action; resting in own bliss it is Śiva, contracting itself called atom, re-manifesting with or without means — will, knowing, action, three immersions plus a fourth taught here in order.
